title: Not Even One & More Than: たりとも, だに, はおろか, もさることながら, にとどまらず, ただ…のみ, ならでは
description: Not a single one, not even (imagine), let alone, not only … but even more, not limited to, nothing but, and unique to.

points.title: 一 + counter + たりとも + negative
points.summary: たりとも = not even one (strong, formal).
points.body:
- 一円**たりとも**無駄にはできない.
- 一日**たりとも**休めない.
examples: {一円|いちえん}たりとも{無駄|むだ}にはできない。
I can't waste a single yen.

points.title: 〜だに: not even (to think of)
points.summary: Fixed: 想像だにしない, 夢にだに思わない, 考えるだに恐ろしい.
points.body: - こんな結果になるとは、想像**だに**しなかった.
examples: {夢|ゆめ}にだに{思|おも}わなかった。
I never even dreamed of it.

points.title: AはおろかBも: let alone A, (not) even B
points.summary: A はおろか B も / さえ / まで = not to mention A, even B — usually in negative or surprising situations.
points.body: - 漢字**はおろか**、ひらがなも書けない.
examples: {貯金|ちょきん}はおろか、{明日|あした}の{食費|しょくひ}もない。
Never mind savings — I don't even have money for tomorrow's food.

points.title: AもさることながらBも: A, of course, but B even more
points.summary: Positive: A is good, needless to say, but B is (even more) notable.
points.body:
- この店は味**もさることながら**、サービスも素晴らしい.
- Compare はおろか: negative context.
examples: この{店|みせ}は{味|あじ}もさることながら、サービスも{素晴|すば}らしい。
The food here is great, of course, but the service is wonderful too.

points.title: 〜にとどまらず: not limited to
points.summary: Noun + にとどまらず = goes beyond A, reaching B.
points.body: - 彼の人気は国内**にとどまらず**、海外にまで広がっている.
examples: {彼|かれ}の{人気|にんき}は{国内|こくない}にとどまらず、{海外|かいがい}にまで{広|ひろ}がっている。
His popularity isn't limited to Japan — it has spread abroad.

points.title: ただ〜のみ(だ): nothing but
points.summary: ただ + verb / noun + のみ = only, all that's left (formal).
points.body: - あとは**ただ**結果を待つ**のみ**だ.
examples: あとはただ{祈|いの}るのみだ。
All we can do now is pray.

points.title: 〜ならでは: unique to
points.summary: Noun + ならではの + noun = only possible with / characteristic of N.
points.body:
- 京都**ならでは**の景色.
- 手作り**ならでは**の温かみ.
examples: これは{京都|きょうと}ならではの{景色|けしき}だ。
This is a view you can only get in Kyoto.

questions.prompt: {一円|いちえん}（　）{無駄|むだ}にはできない。
questions.explanation: Not a single one: **たりとも + negative**.
notes: なりとも = 'even a little (at least)' — used with positive wishes, not 一円…ない.
questions.translation: I can't waste a single yen.

questions.prompt: {試験|しけん}まであと{一週間|いっしゅうかん}。{一日|いちにち}（　）{休|やす}んではいられない。
notes: ならでは = 'unique to' — it doesn't go with a single day and a negative.
questions.translation: One week until the exam — I can't afford to take a single day off.

questions.prompt: こんな{結果|けっか}になるとは、{想像|そうぞう}（　）しなかった。
notes: 想像だけしなかった = 'only didn't imagine' — illogical.
questions.translation: I never even imagined it would turn out like this.

questions.prompt: What does 「{夢|ゆめ}にだに{思|おも}わなかった。」 mean?
options: I only thought about it in dreams.
I didn't think it was a dream.
I never even dreamed of it.
I dreamed about it every night.
notes: It's about not imagining it at all.

questions.prompt: {彼|かれ}は{漢字|かんじ}（　）、ひらがなも{書|か}けない。
notes: もさることながら is for positive praise.
をおいて = 'apart from (… no one else)'.
questions.translation: Never mind kanji — he can't even write hiragana.

questions.prompt: {貯金|ちょきん}（　）、{明日|あした}の{食費|しょくひ}もない。
questions.translation: Never mind savings — I don't even have money for tomorrow's food.

questions.prompt: この{店|みせ}は{味|あじ}（　）、サービスも{素晴|すば}らしい。
questions.explanation: A of course, B too (praise): **もさることながら**.
notes: はおろか is for negative contexts ('let alone').
questions.translation: The food here is great, of course, but the service is wonderful too.

questions.prompt: What does 「{彼|かれ}の{演技|えんぎ}は{技術|ぎじゅつ}もさることながら、{表現力|ひょうげんりょく}が{素晴|すば}らしい。」 mean?
options: He has no technique, let alone expressiveness.
His technique is better than his expressiveness.
His technique is good, of course, but his expressiveness is even more impressive.
Leaving technique aside, he has no expressiveness.
questions.explanation: もさることながら = **A, and especially B**.
notes: That would be はおろか.

questions.prompt: その{問題|もんだい}は{一企業|いちきぎょう}（　）、{業界全体|ぎょうかいぜんたい}に{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}えた。
questions.explanation: Not limited to: **にとどまらず**.
notes: はおろか = 'let alone' (usually negative) — here the effect spreads outward.
にたえず isn't the pattern.
questions.translation: The problem didn't stop at one company — it affected the whole industry.

questions.prompt: {彼|かれ}の{人気|にんき}は{国内|こくない}（　）、{海外|かいがい}にまで{広|ひろ}がっている。
notes: ならでは = 'unique to' — it needs の + noun after it.
questions.translation: His popularity isn't limited to Japan — it has spread abroad.

questions.prompt: やるべきことは{全部|ぜんぶ}やった。あとはただ{結果|けっか}を{待|ま}つ（　）だ。
notes: たりとも follows 一 + counter and needs a negative.
questions.translation: I've done everything I had to — now all that's left is to wait for the results.

questions.prompt: What does 「あとはただ{祈|いの}るのみだ。」 mean?
options: All we can do now is pray.
We pray, and then it's over.

questions.prompt: これは{京都|きょうと}（　）の{景色|けしき}だ。
notes: ならいざしらず = 'maybe for A, but …'.
だに is for 'not even (imagine)' — 京都だにの isn't grammatical.
questions.translation: This is a view you can only get in Kyoto.

questions.prompt: このセーターには{手作|てづく}り（　）の{温|あたた}かみがある。
questions.translation: This jumper has the warmth only a handmade one can have.
